name: Claude Legault
bio: Claude Legault (born May 26, 1963) is a Québec film and television actor, writer and director.

credits.title: La symphonie du sens
credits.overview: Ten-year-old Sam sees his father Richard reappear after a long absence. The reassuring world she shared with her mother and stepfather is shaken. Richard, with his excesses and vulnerabilities, disrupts her sense of security. In this tender chaos, will Sam be able to keep her light alive?
